note: Illustrative house method. Assess jobs, not people. Validate with a competent evaluator before use. This is not the gradar method.

factors.name: Skills and knowledge
levels: Resolve unfamiliar problems using specialist knowledge

factors.name: Mental, physical and emotional effort
levels: Frequent intense demands requiring recovery planning
Sustained complex demands with exceptional recovery needs

factors.name: Responsibility and impact
levels: Accountable for a complete service or process
Accountable for significant resources or service outcomes
Accountable for outcomes across several functions

factors.name: Working conditions
levels: Occasional difficult environmental or interpersonal conditions
Frequent demanding conditions requiring substantial controls
Persistent demanding conditions requiring extensive controls
